items.quote: Kel did an absolutely amazing job with my son. My son was crying, moving around, and having a hard time sitting still, but Kel never once got frustrated or made us feel rushed. He stayed calm, patient, and understanding throughout the entire haircut.
Rawest barber in Gainesville for sure.
